name: Nandini Mitra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nandini Mitra is a Kolkata-based poet and teacher with a postgraduate degree in English literature from Jadavpur University. Her literary interests are joined by training in classical singing. Her poetry collection The Road to Tranquility is noted in her Literary Vibes contributor biography, and her poems also appear in Saaranga and Our Poetry Archive.

In her Kabita Live poem ‘I’m Falling Apart’, a wish to live fully in the present coexists with a sense of loss. The speaker imagines carrying the ocean’s sound inside a conch shell but being unable to reach the place it recalls. That distance between an inward echo and an unreachable destination gives the poem its tension.
